title: LFU Replacement (4 entries)
constraints: Each of the 4 entries has a 3-bit use counter. `counts` packs them: entry i at `counts[3i+2:3i]`. Reset sets all counters to 0.
`victim` = the entry with the smallest count. Ties go to the **lowest index**.
Rising edge with `fill = 1`: the current victim is replaced, so its counter becomes 1 (`hit` is ignored this cycle).
Otherwise, with `hit = 1`: the counter of entry `way` increments, **saturating at 7**.
When an increment makes a counter reach 7, **all** counters are halved (shift right by 1) on that same edge, so frequencies age. Must be synthesizable.
hints: Compute the victim combinationally: compare the four counters with a small tournament that prefers the lower index on ties.
Handle priorities in one clocked block: reset, then fill, then hit.
Aging: compute the incremented counter first. If it equals 7, write every counter (including that new value) shifted right by one.

examples.title: hot entry
examples.expected: entry 2 is never the victim while others have lower counts
